basics.name: Xavier Saliniere
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with a frontend focus and over 10 years of experience building enterprise applications, particularly in the fields of security, operations, and data analysis. I also had the opportunity to design a conversational AI agent as part of an application enabling the querying and interpretation of data extracted from Bell Canada's customer service interaction database. I have 6 years of experience with Angular, 4 years with Vue.js, 6 years with Java (including 3 with Spring Boot), and 3 years with Python Django.

work.name: Bell Canada (via Talan)
work.summary:
At Bell Canada's Operations Center, I created and contributed to the development of various enterprise platforms in the fields of security and data analysis and visualization.

Technologies: Vue.js (versions 2 and 3), React, TypeScript, Pinia, TailwindCSS, Vite, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Java Spring Boot, Python Django, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Keycloak, Vitest, Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Google ADK (AI agent).
highlights: Development of the Insights platform (Vue3/Spring Boot) — AI-powered customer service analytics platform used by over 1,100 users. Built a conversational agent from scratch, enabling natural language querying of the customer service interaction database as well as chart generation. Also developed a caching system using MongoDB (recommending a migration to Redis).

Created the new Frontend application for the WAF management platform — Migration of the React frontend to Vue3. Features including firewall policy configuration, virtual servers, ASM signatures, telemetry, integration with F5 and backend services written in Go and Spring Boot.
Took over development of the vulnerability management platform — Platform for tracking and remediating security vulnerabilities across Bell's entire infrastructure (Vue2/Django).
Development of the EDR platform — Event detection and response platform for real-time coordination of security incidents with SentinelOne integration (Vue2/Spring Boot).
Development of the new Phisherman Frontend — Phishing detection and analysis platform, integrating URLScan.io, Symantec, and Wildfire (Vue3/Django, Elasticsearch).
Took over development of SLURP — Asset management system with barcode tracking and application health monitoring (Vue2/Django).
Created the UCDB (Unified Configuration Database) platform with API documentation and field management (Vue3/Spring Boot).

work.name: Renault Digital (via Onepoint)
work.summary:
Led the Frontend architecture of PRISM — a modular web application for automotive component definition and validation, used by multiple stakeholder roles throughout the vehicle development lifecycle.

Technologies: Angular 8+, TypeScript, Redux, Material Design, GitLab CI/CD, Jest, Cypress.
highlights: Built modular views for a cPDM application (Angular) — enabling designers, engineers, procurement teams, and compliance specialists to define, configure, and validate automotive components including parts, materials, and color/trim variants
Established coding standards, architectural decisions, and development practices for the frontend team; integrated with Java/Spring Boot backend services and collaborated on API contract design
Reduced automotive component validation cycle time by enabling parallel stakeholder reviews within a single source of truth for product data, catching design conflicts earlier in the design phase

work.name: Yanport
work.summary:
Full-Stack development of property aggregation and estimation platforms for real estate professionals, providing agents and agencies with tools for market monitoring, property search, and decision support.

Technologies: Angular.js, Angular 4+, JavaScript, TypeScript, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Java 8+, Eclipse Jersey.
highlights: Platform aggregating property listings from over 10 sources with advanced search, filtering, report generation, and proposal creation for real estate professionals
AngularJS to Angular 5 migration — implemented Progressive Web App capabilities, responsive design for mobile and tablet, and modernized the frontend architecture
Developed backend services for real-time data updates, search optimization, and crawling infrastructure powering the aggregation pipeline
